lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Wednesday, where they'll consider Resolution 2026-34 to adjust Area Median Income limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park — a technical-sounding item that directly shapes who qualifies for local housing. Also worth watching: the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments on forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy Thursday, and Ridgway Town Council meets Wednesday to ratify letters supporting a federal disaster declaration tied to the Gold Mountain Fire, which has scorched nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support for Gold Mountain Fire's regional damage.
